exposure: SARS-CoV-2 infection in pregnant women (symptomatic and asymptomatic)
cohort: The study participants consisted of pregnant women, divided into an exposed group with SARS-CoV-2 infection and a control group without SARS-CoV-2 infection.
finding: The study found no significant differences in the frequency of abnormal intrapartum cardiotocography patterns or perinatal outcomes between SARS-CoV-2 positive pregnant women and SARS-CoV-2 negative controls, nor between symptomatic and asymptomatic infected women.
